## What do we mean by 'qualitative?'

### The data is not numbers

::: quote
"Qualitative data, in contrast, is about qualities: information that does not involve numbers or numerical data" @guyan2022.
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### In-depth

::: quote
"Broadly, qualitative research is generally employed to support a researcher in generating a deep and nuanced understanding of a given phenomenon." [@lester2020, p. 95].
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Answers certain types of questions

::: quote
“Qualitative research is great for addressing “how” questions—rather than “how many”; for understanding the world from the perspective of those studied (i.e., informants); and for examining and articulating processes.” [@pratt2009, p. 856]
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Not a thing, actually

::: quote
In a strict sense, there is no such thing as “qualitative research.” [@small2022, p. 20]
:::
